newsitem.title: UK: NWE gas oil steady but buyer interest seen.
newsitem.headline: NWE gas oil steady but buyer interest seen.

text.p: NWE oil products were steady on Tuesday, traders said.
Gas oil differentials were steady, with interest from buyers despite dollar strength. July IPE rose $1.50 to $166.75 a tonne.
Gasoline was little changed with July swaps trading at $186.25 a tonne but no trade on physical barges.

High sulphur barges traded steady in the top end of Monday's range at $84.50 and $84.75 fob ARA but traders said they expected to see lower numbers in the afternoon saying the trades were attempts to keep prices at their current levels.
Low sulphur barges were unchanged at $95/$97 in a very quiet market.
High sulphur cargoes were largely steady with one Russian M-100 straight-run reported traded at two means plus $2.
